meta.description: Daily 07:00 IST: scans the school gallery for new review-approved photos/videos not yet posted, checks which channels are connected (Meta/Instagram/Telegram), and has Sonnet draft a caption + tagline per pick in the family's language. Nothing posts — the daily note and each draft (gallery content id + caption + channels) go to the director for approval; captions never name a child.
